name: tikk
author: Erik Fillipsveen
description: Apple Reminders in the Omarchy bar, through a confined SSH key to a Mac you own. Pill with the open count of one list, a keyboard panel to tick and add, and a window laid out like Reminders.app.

barWidget.description: Open reminders in your list. Dimmed = the Mac gateway is unreachable. Left-click = panel, middle-click = refresh.

schema.label: Reminders list
schema.description: Name of the list to show (empty = the first list the Mac reports)
